items.title: Erasca’s early data show profile that could challenge RevMed in pancreatic cancer: Analysts
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): In updated Phase 1 data, Erasca’s ERAS-0015 showed a robust response rate in pancreatic cancer subgroups where Revolution Medicines’ recently-approved Rasonque was weaker, leading Jefferies to write that the investigational molecular glue could have an advantage over the approved therapy.

items.title: Sharon Mates’ next act: Ritzey banks $112M to target Down syndrome and diabetes
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): After J&J’s $14.6 billion buyout of Intra-Cellular Therapies, the biotech’s former CEO Sharon Mates is still chasing intracellular signaling, this time with Ritzey Therapeutics for metabolic and neurologic diseases.

items.title: Invivyd plans FDA run for COVID-19 preventative, teeing up ‘new era for immunization’
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): Invivyd plans on ushering in a “new era for immunization” with its COVID-19 prevention antibody that is designed using the same antibody backbone as the biotech’s emergency-authorized Pemgarda.

items.title: Capricor CEO says FDA never gave DMD cell therapy a ‘fair shake’
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The FDA rejected Capricor Therapeutics’ Duchenne muscular dystrophy cell therapy for a second time on Friday, citing data integrity issues. CEO Linda Marbán told BioSpace she was shocked and explains why she thinks this reason is suspect.

items.title: Lilly buys Huntington’s drug developer LoQus23 in potentially $725M deal
items.summary: 출처 피드 발췌 (원문 언어 · 분석 전): The acquisition hands Lilly what could become a first-of-its-kind treatment designed to inhibit a protein, “MSH3,” that can exacerbate the genetic abnormalities underlying diseases like Huntington's.
